root_cause: Hold-pass double count. At s7454 r3 obj_center was enemy_weak (friendly_oc 5 incl. 1 Beta model = OC 3, enemy_oc 8 -> need 4). Beta (already_on_obj) was assigned HOLD and the hold pass subtracted Beta's whole unit OC 9 from the need (remaining 0), although Beta's in-range OC is already in friendly_oc and staying adds nothing. The centre then read 'already taken by Beta', pass 2 skipped it for every unit (Gamma's top score 44.4, Alpha's 58.1) and Gamma got the next objective needing OC: a lone 9 vs 14 flip of obj_nml_1 (score 15.0). A vs B records (2 seeds): with Gamma advancing to the centre P2 scored hold_new +3 at end of round 3 and P1's per_objective primary fell 10 -> 5 in rounds 3/4 (the centre flipped), i.e. the gain is primary on obj_center.
fix_summary: One extra condition in the existing hold pass of _assign_units_to_objectives: when FIX_LONE_FLIP is on and the held objective's state is enemy_weak / enemy_strong / contested, the holder's oc_consumed is 0 and obj_oc_remaining is left unchanged (its in-range OC is already in oc_needed). Held objectives (held_safe / held_threatened) and every other pass are untouched. Logs [LONE_FLIP] when it fires. FIX_LONE_FLIP=0 restores base exactly.

fires: 5 [LONE_FLIP] lines across 6 one-round replays (both players, decision round to end of next round): s7454 2 (P2 obj_center at the finding; P1 obj_center 5 vs 14 later), s7431 1 (P2 obj_home_2 3 vs 5), s7455 r2 1 (P1 obj_home_2 4 vs 6), s7455 r3 1 (P2 obj_home_2 3 vs 6), s7457 0, s7458 0. ~0-2 per ~1.5 rounds; only planning passes with a partial holder on an objective the enemy controls. Only the s7454 fire was checked to change the focal decision; the others' downstream changes were not inspected individually.
risks: (1) More units drawn to objectives the enemy controls where we already have a partial holder (often our own home under pressure, as in 3 of 5 fires); with several holders/arrivals this could stack OC beyond what is needed and thin coverage of far objectives that secondaries (Engage on All Fronts, Centre Ground variants) reward in rounds 3-5. (2) A holder that is about to die or be pushed off still counts in friendly_oc, so the need may be under-estimated as before; the fix does not address that. (3) At the finding the unit that changes is Alpha (not Gamma) and Gamma now takes a 3-turn trip to home_2; over a full game the mixed reassignment was not measured beyond 6 one-round seeds. (4) Value was not measured with the fix in one seat only over full games; the round-2 lesson applies.
